description.value: Cream Pony is a casual counter-service spot on Main Street in Vancouver's Mount Pleasant neighbourhood specializing in fried chicken and donuts, with a second location in North Vancouver's Shipyard District. The shop has built a loyal following for its glazed donuts and juicy chicken sandwiches. It also offers catering and is available through major delivery platforms.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: stands (2 spaces) at 27m; rack (3 spaces, covered) at 42m; stands (6 spaces, covered) at 65m. Total: 11 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms an active business at 2190 Main Street, Vancouver (Mount Pleasant), matching the OSM address, and provides a phone number (604-565-4604) not present in OSM. The site confirms takeout ordering via online shop, Skip the Dishes, DoorDash, and Uber Eats. No evidence on the website for bike parking, water refill, or washrooms, so all required WWC criteria remain unconfirmed.
concerns: OSM opening_hours (We-Su 07:00-18:00) conflicts with website which states Mount Pleasant is open MON-SUN 7am-7pm — both day range and closing time differ.
OSM has no phone number; 604-565-4604 sourced from website for the Mount Pleasant/Vancouver location.
